verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own documentation describes a self-hosted On-premise edition for organizations that want to manage their own data, which lets a customer decide where data lives by running it in their own environment. There is no evidence of selectable hosted regions or data-residency options in the SaaS offering. Missing for 10: documented hosted region/residency selection (e.g. EU vs US data centers), details on On-premise deployment locations and availability, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: BugSnag On-premise offers a self-hosted version of BugSnag for organizations that need or want to manage their own data.
